name: VicRoads registration concession for Health Care Card holders
summary: Half-price vehicle registration fee in Victoria for one private vehicle owned by a Health Care Card holder.
key: 50% discount on registration fee (Health Care Card; no discount on the TAC fee).
who: Primary cardholder (or spouse/domestic partner) named on the renewal notice
One vehicle used privately for social, domestic or recreational purposes
how: Log in to myVicRoads, select Vehicles & Registration, then Apply for registration concession.
Apply at least 5 days before the due date and wait for confirmation before renewing.
catches: No discount on the TAC fee for Health Care Card holders.
Concession card eligibility will be checked with the responsible authority before the concession is granted.
